test_group_shift_with_null_key: test groupby shift with null keys to verify no segfault on partially missing group-by keys
test_group_shift_with_fill_value: test groupby shift with fill_value to verify missing values are filled with a specified value
test_group_shift_lose_timezone: test groupby shift preserves timezone information on timestamp columns
test_group_diff_real_series: test groupby diff on numeric series to verify correct dtype promotion for small integer types
test_group_diff_datetimelike: test groupby diff on datetime and timedelta columns to verify correct date arithmetic
